documents.title: Woodruff County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 22 pages. Amounts are the "Total Appropriation" (p. 2) for funds; "Budget" column of the line-item exhibit for departments and categories column. The document is a scan; it was read with optical character recognition, and every parent total was checked against its parts.
